title: MedConceal: A Benchmark for Clinical Hidden-Concern Reasoning Under Partial Observability
abstract: arXiv:2604.08788v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Patient-clinician communication is an asymmetric-information problem: patients often do not disclose fears, misconceptions, or practical barriers unless clinicians elicit them skillfully. Effective medical dialogue therefore requires reasoning under partial observability: clinicians must elicit latent concerns, confirm them through interaction, and respond in ways that guide patients toward appropriate care. However, existing medical dialogue benchmarks largely sidestep this challenge by exposing hidden patient state, collapsing elicitation into extraction, or evaluating responses without modeling what remains hidden. We present MedConceal, a benchmark with an interactive patient simulator for evaluating hidden-concern reasoning in medical dialogue, comprising 300 curated cases and 600 clinician-LLM interactions. Built from clinician-answered online health discussions, each case pairing clinician-visible context with simulator-intern

translated_title: MedConceal：部分可观测性下的临床隐性担忧推理基准
translated_abstract: 医患沟通本质上是一个信息不对称问题：除非临床医生巧妙地加以引导，否则患者往往不会主动透露自己的恐惧、误解或实际就医障碍。因此，有效的医疗对话需要在部分可观测性条件下进行推理：临床医生必须引导出患者的潜在担忧，通过互动加以确认，并以引导患者获得适当医疗照护的方式作出回应。然而，现有的医疗对话基准大多回避了这一挑战：它们或者直接暴露患者的隐藏状态，将“引导”简化为“提取”，或者在不建模剩余隐藏信息的情况下评估回复质量。我们提出了 MedConceal，这是一个配备交互式患者模拟器的基准，用于评估医疗对话中的隐性担忧推理能力，包含300个精心筛选的案例和600次临床医生-大语言模型交互。该基准基于临床医生回答过的在线健康讨论构建，每个案例将临床医生可见的上下文与模拟器内部隐藏的患者状态进行配对……
tldr: MedConceal 提出了一个配备交互式患者模拟器的新基准，通过向模型隐藏患者的真实担忧，在300个案例和600次交互中评估大语言模型在部分可观测条件下主动引导、确认并回应患者隐性担忧的推理能力。
en_tdlr: MedConceal introduces a benchmark with an interactive patient simulator that conceals patients' true concerns from LLMs, evaluating hidden-concern reasoning—the ability to elicit, confirm, and respond to latent patient worries under partial observability—across 300 curated cases and 600 clinician-LLM interactions.
